prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready transparent cutout blacksmith workshop building sprite for a western medieval fantasy territory-building map.
Primary request: a compact medieval blacksmith's shop, matching a finely painted, realistically textured strategy-game building set, with readable silhouette at small scale.
Subject: a modest one-story timber-framed stone workshop, weathered dark oak beams, warm pale plaster, old russet-brown clay roof tiles, one substantial soot-darkened stone chimney, and an attached open forge bay. Under the bay roof show a small warmly glowing charcoal forge, an anvil on a thick wooden block and restrained hand tools, a small rack of iron bars, one quenching barrel. These are integrated parts of this single compact building. No people, animals, nearby buildings, weapons display hall or fantasy magic effects.
Style/medium: richly detailed realistic hand-painted medieval strategy-game sprite, natural aged stone and oak texture, crisp painterly edges, believable materials and proportions, no thick outlines, no cartoon exaggeration, no low-poly toy rendering.
Composition/framing: square canvas, elevated three-quarter front view, front and one side visible, modest amount of roof visible, orthographic feel consistent with a placed medieval tavern sprite. Complete single building centered with transparent padding, all chimney and roof tips inside the canvas. A very thin irregular stone foundation immediately under the building and working bay; no scenic ground island or thick floating pedestal, no landscape.
Lighting: soft neutral daylight from upper left with warm forge glow confined to the forge opening; contact shadows confined to actual building footprint. No smoke cloud that obscures silhouette, no snow.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the entire sprite and open gaps. No sky, horizon, opaque solid backdrop, drawn checkerboard or rectangular ground tile. Solid building surfaces must be opaque; soft antialiasing only at silhouette edge. No white halo, red or magenta fringe.
Text: none; no letters, labels, logos, watermarks, UI, grid or frame. Render one finished high-resolution square image only.
